test_case.test_name: One-shot topology-bound PCIe Correctable LCRC TX RAS injection
test_case.purpose: On a dedicated SUT, inject exactly one approved PCIe LCRC TX correctable error into the live-mapped GPU path and prove corrected handling through amdgpuras, host APEI/AER BadTLP, unchanged PCIe enumeration and correlated BMC evidence without sharing row-1532 thermal results.
required_package: Exact row-2047 variant and explicit row-1532 thermal exclusion; dedicated SUT, console, isolation and maintenance approval
Approved BIOS AER Enabled/Firmware First/DPC DownStream Port/DS Hotplug Disabled recipe plus initial/final settings
Signed amdgpu/amdgpuras versions and semantic approval for `-b 5 -s 1 -t 2 -m 0 -d 0`
Live device/card/BDF/socket/GPU identity and endpoint-root/switch/downstream-port topology map
Expected corrected APEI/AER/BadTLP and BMC CPER/SEL/Dump fields, correlation window and protected TLS endpoint
Explicit one-injection authorization, abort limits and recovery/reboot/service-restoration procedure
test_case.test_command: DESTRUCTIVE ONE-SHOT GATE; preserve baseline dmesg/journal/CPER/SEL/Dump and PCIe topology without clearing. An authorized operator verifies only the four required BIOS settings and recovery. Load the approved driver/tool, capture complete `amdgpuras -l` and bind device 0 to immutable GPU/BDF/socket and downstream path. After explicit authorization naming that tuple, run the exact approved injection once. Capture full tool output and monotonic/wall timestamps; collect complete new APEI/AER/BadTLP context, re-enumerate PCIe, and securely GET all relevant BMC log pages. Correlate severity, target/upstream/downstream identities and time. Never substitute row 1532, repeat injection or reboot automatically.
test_case.expected_result: The one authorized target reports injection success; only the expected corrected Firmware-First APEI/AER BadTLP path and matching BMC record appear within the approved window, no uncorrected/fatal condition occurs, all expected GPU/PCIe identities remain enumerated and services stay healthy or recover exactly as documented.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires dedicated isolation/recovery, exact live target binding, approved tuple and one-run authorization, corrected host/BMC correlation, unchanged topology and post-health. FAIL on wrong/ambiguous target, unexpected severity/type/path, missing host or BMC evidence, uncorrected/fatal event, device/topology loss, hang or recovery failure. Missing tool semantics/map/recovery/approval is NOT READY; no retry or partial PASS.
safety_gate: Dedicated SUT, console, signed topology, approved tool/tuple, expected records and tested recovery are mandatory.
One explicit authorization permits one injection into one named physical path; no substitution or automatic repeat.
Preserve all baseline/failure logs; use protected authenticated TLS Redfish and never clear evidence.
Abort on uncorrected/fatal severity, wrong target/path, GPU loss, hang, topology/service change or unexpected recovery need.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/Variant/hash and row-1532 isolation record
BIOS before/after evidence, tool/version/tuple approval and dedicated-SUT/recovery authorization
Complete live GPU/device/card/BDF/socket/downstream topology and pre-injection PCIe/log baselines
Single amdgpuras command/output/exit with target binding and timestamps
Complete post APEI/AER BadTLP, PCIe enumeration and paginated BMC CPER/SEL/Dump correlation
Abort/no-clear/no-retry audit, recovery/health evidence and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong identity, uncorrected/fatal event, GPU loss, hang or topology/service regression, stop collection/injection and preserve console, PCIe, APEI/AER and BMC evidence. Isolate the SUT; do not inject again or reboot automatically. Invoke only the pre-approved recovery with a new human release, verify full topology/services and restore approved BIOS settings before disposition.
